changelog: Fixes two real bugs in the early boot splash confirmed via fbi's own documentation: (1) -noverbose was invalid syntax the whole time (fbi's actual option is -v/--(no)verbose, requiring double-dash --noverbose for the negated long form - a single dash gets parsed as a string of unrelated short flags instead), now also adds --nointeractive explicitly; (2) the systemd unit used Type=simple, but fbi actually daemonizes itself (forks a child and exits the original process almost immediately) - confirmed by systemd's own logs showing the tracked main PID exit successfully while a completely different PID had to be force-killed later. The unit now uses Type=forking, letting systemd correctly auto-detect the real long-lived process. NOTE: the etc-systemd-system/pinclock-early-splash.service unit file itself is NOT part of this OTA update (it lives outside the OTA-managed tree, like device_identity.py) - re-run deploy_manual_files.sh to pick up the Type=forking fix; a firmware update alone only fixes the -noverbose/--nointeractive script flags.
